page_title: BOU 2-2 MNU | Bournemouth v Manchester Utd 20/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+11' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
90+10' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
90+7' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+6' Here's the change. Amad Diallo leaves the pitch and Mason Mount (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
90+5' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Stuart Attwell had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' Evanilson (Bournemouth) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
90+3' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
90+2' What was Adam Smith (Bournemouth) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+1' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) sends a chip pass into the box, but Senne Lammens is quickest to intercept the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
89' Ben Doak (Bournemouth) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Rayan will be replaced by Ben Doak (Bournemouth).
86' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) commits a rough challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for an infringement.
82' Michael Carrick decides to make a substitution. Casemiro will be replaced by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
82' Substitution. Matheus Cunha will be replaced by Ayden Heaven (Manchester United).
81' 2 - 2 Goal! Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Senne Lammens to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
80' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

78' It's a foul from Harry Maguire (Manchester United). Surprisingly, the referee comes and pulls out a red card. It was a very harsh one and Harry Maguire (Manchester United) complains, but it's no use of course. The decision has been made.
78' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul. Penalty! A huge opportunity to score for Bournemouth.
76' Senne Lammens leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
76' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
73' Substitution. Ryan Christie makes way for Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth).
73' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Alejandro Jimenez and he is replaced by Adam Smith (Bournemouth).
73' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Amine Adli is replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
71' 1 - 2 James Hill (Bournemouth) is totally disorientated and accidentally puts the ball into his own goal!
71' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
71' The substitution is prepared. Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Bryan Mbeumo.
70' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and Manchester Utd manage to earn a corner.
67' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Adrien Truffert provided an assist for the goal.
67' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
65' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

64' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester Utd will take a corner.
64' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle and it's Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
61' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Djordje Petrovic no chance!
60' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
59' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
59' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth). It's a penalty to Manchester Utd! Let's see who's going to take it.
59' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
55' A rebound sits up perfectly for Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
52' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
52' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
49' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
46' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
46' Half-chance! Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) plays a pass into the box, but Djordje Petrovic reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Stuart Attwell has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner but it's cleared.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Half-chance! Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) plays a pass into the box, but Senne Lammens reacts well to snuff out the attack.
43' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) sends a chip pass into the box, but Senne Lammens is quickest to intercept the ball.
42' Rayan (Bournemouth) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.

41' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) latches on to a lofted pass from the free kick and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box. His effort towards the top right corner is saved by the excellent Senne Lammens.
40' Stuart Attwell blows his whistle. Leny Yoro (Manchester United) commits a foul after dangerous play.
38' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) will take a corner kick.
36' Chance! Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards goal, but Senne Lammens is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
36' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

35' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
35' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
32' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
31' Casemiro (Manchester United) sends a long cross over to Bruno Fernandes, but Djordje Petrovic comes forward to gather the ball.
30' The players claim that Rayan (Bournemouth) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right.
28' Casemiro (Manchester United) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
27' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
25' The corner from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is hurriedly cleared.

25' This should have been a goal! Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) sends a killer pass into the box, but Amad Diallo can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
23' A sweet pass inside the box gives Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
22' The resulting corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

22' Rayan (Bournemouth) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Senne Lammens easily deals with the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
20' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) whips in a cross from the corner, but Djordje Petrovic is well positioned and punches the ball away.
19' Evanilson (Bournemouth) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stuart Attwell has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
17' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
17' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Manchester Utd have a corner.
16' Leny Yoro (Manchester United) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.

15' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
15' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
13' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Stuart Attwell stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
12' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) makes a strong challenge and Stuart Attwell blows for a foul.
11' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

11' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Djordje Petrovic makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Manchester Utd get a corner.
9' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game. One of the players from Manchester Utd won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
5' Chance! Evanilson (Bournemouth) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
5' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the top left corner, but Djordje Petrovic pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
3' Evanilson (Bournemouth) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
2' The resulting corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
2' A pass into the penalty area from Evanilson (Bournemouth) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
